results.title: NYC Schools Account (NYCSA)
results.content:
Restricted Parents (parents with court orders or an order of protection that limits their access to their child and education records) must contact the school to create a NYCSA account.

Once the school confirms with your child’s custodial parent or guardian that they have the most up-to-date order of protection on file, Restricted Parents will be able to create a NYCSA with limited access to information based on the order of protection in our systems. For example, most Restricted Parents will be able to see their child’s academic information, but not their contact information.

### Sharing Access

You can invite other adults—like relatives or a tutor—to see information about your child on NYCSA. Some of the information on NYCSA is private, so be careful about who you invite. [...] ### To delete your NYCSA:

### Sign up for an account and add students

You can sign up for an account by entering a few basic details. This will allow you to begin receiving notifications from NYCPS. It only takes five minutes, and it is the first step in getting a full account. Review the NYCSA Setup Guide for detailed information about setting up an account.

You must add students to your account to see more detailed information. Once you have done this, you can enjoy all the benefits NYCSA provides.

If you do not have a creation code, or the school did not send you a letter about NYCSA, you will have to register in-person or teleconference into a school. Use the Find a School tool to get your child’s school’s contact and location information.

results.title: NYCPS Resources & NYC Schools Account | District 32
results.content:
What is NYC Schools Account (NYCSA)?  
NYCSA is a web-based application that lets you to see your child’s academic and biographic information on any computer, phone, or tablet. The application is translated into nine languages other than English!   
In the account, you can see your child’s: • Assessments (Test Scores) • Attendance • Enrollment History • Grades • Graduation Tracker • Guardians • Health Information (Fitnessgram) • Individualized Education Program (IEP) Information • Promotion Tracker • Reading Level • Schedule • Student Documents (Report Card, Transcript, Summer School Letter) • Transportation   
 How do I create an NYC Schools Account?
